text:
Notice for Consumer  regarding to update your bill immediately
Dear consumer,
Your electricity power connection will be Disconnected tonight 09:00 pm. Because your previous month bill was not updated , please immediately call our electricity officer Mr Devesh joshi
ministry of power would like to calrify that alth[…] encou[…] our consumer's to always keep updated.
Now you update your bill  by just calling our […] number .
To update your bill call our electrici[…] helpl[…] number:-
0824-060-6707
• Follow our official social media accounts @ministryofpower on twiter , facebook , instgram and YouTube
cheif electricity officer
notes: Electricity-disconnection scam dressed as a Ministry of Power notice (letterhead: 'विद्युत मंत्रालय MINISTRY OF POWER'). Other copies with different phone numbers are on PDF pages 34, 211 and 241. […] marks text hidden on the page itself (FAKE stamp, blur or an overlay); nothing was filled in. Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined. Page number is the PDF page (1-based). The year of tweets shown without a year is inferred from the compilation's reverse-date order (it was made on 2024-02-02).
